Subject: Post-demo recap + proposed next steps (privacy + SOC 2)

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

- Key pain: you want predictable latency for inference across internal dashboards while ensuring no PII flows to hosted logs.
- Ask: confirmation of our SOC 2 status, GDPR/HIPAA applicability for the telemetry and console, and starting the vendor security questionnaire.
- Short-term approach we suggested: use Dedicated capacity for production workloads and enable prefix/KV caching in the console to reduce token footprint.

Next steps I propose:
1) I will share a stub SOC 2 report and our vendor questionnaire template (attached).
2) Please flag any privacy-specific questions you want answered for the Console and the public docs (cookies/tracking).
3) We can schedule a 30-min security call next week with our security lead if you want to review compliance details.

Attachments: SOC2_report_2025.pdf (stub), Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (stub)

Would Tuesday or Wednesday morning PT work for a quick call?

Best,
Aisha

Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + proposed next steps (privacy + SOC 2)

Thanks Aisha — helpful recap. A few clarifying items from our side before we lock a call: 

1) SOC 2: can you confirm the scope (type II, systems covered, last audit date)? We need the exact control coverage for our procurement team.
2) GDPR / HIPAA: we are a data processor for a small subset of health-related customers. Does Redwood offer a HIPAA BA (Business Associate) option for Dedicated/private deployments, and if so, is that limited to Private (on-prem/VPC)?
3) Console telemetry & cookies: our product security lead wants a short matrix showing what console features set cookies/local storage (e.g., session, analytics) and whether those are sent to hosted telemetry or kept on the client. We also need to understand cookie lifetimes and opt-out behavior for our EU users.

We will start the Vendor Security Questionnaire but would appreciate the SOC 2 stub and any cookie/telemetry matrix first so we can pre-fill relevant sections. 

Thanks — Priya
Priya Shah
Head of Procurement | Acme Analytics

Hi Priya —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers inline and attachments: 

1) SOC 2: we are Type II, report covers our hosted API, Dedicated control plane, and core telemetry pipelines. Last audit: July 2025. I've attached a redacted SOC 2 report (SOC2_report_2025.pdf) — legal has redacted client-identifying info.

2) HIPAA / BA: Redwood offers a Business Associate Agreement for customers who require HIPAA. That option is available for Dedicated and Private deployments; hosted customers can be supported with contractual safeguards but Dedicated/Private are recommended for strict BA controls. I can loop in our legal if you want the BA template.

3) Console telemetry & cookies: attached is a quick privacy-cookie-matrix.csv that maps Console features to cookie/local storage usage and whether those telemetry events are sent to our hosted analytics. Highlights: session cookie for auth (expires on browser close by default, configurable TTL for Dedicated), analytics cookies for aggregated telemetry (30 days, opt-out via console settings), and no PII in telemetry by default (we truncate identifiers; you can enable prefix-hashing). See the attachment for itemized lines.

I've also attached our Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx prefilled with high-level answers on access controls and encryption; please mark sections you want more detail on.

Proposed next action: 30-min call with our security lead (Marissa) and Karthik to walk the SOC 2 scope and cookie matrix. I am available Tue/Wed mornings PT; Marissa can do Wed 10am PT.

Regards,
Aisha

Attachments: Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (stub), privacy-cookie-matrix.csv (stub), SOC2_report_2025.pdf (stub)
